title: Update on the Collateral Ratio Under Portfolio Margin and the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance will update the   collateral ratio  for the following assets under Portfolio Margin from  2025-10-07 06:00 (UTC) and 2025-10-10 06:00 (UTC).  The update will be completed within approximately  30 minutes . The update will be completed within approximately one hour. Please note: Existing positions opened before the update  will be affected ; Futures running grid might  expire  due to updates on the leverage and margin tiers, users are advised to adjust accordingly before the change.
